question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Advertisment"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Advertisement".** (विज्ञापन)

 
 
• **Example: **The company launched a new** advertisement** campaign last week.
 
 

Therefore, the correct spelling is:** "Advertisement"**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Adulterous **(व्यभिचारी): Refers to having a sexual relationship outside of marriage.

 
 
• **Example:** He was accused of having an** adulterous **affair.
 
 
 
• **Astounding **(आश्चर्यजनक): Means surprisingly impressive or notable.
 
 
• **Example: **The magician's performance was absolutely **astounding.**
 
 
 
• **Amendment** (संशोधन): Means a minor change or addition designed to improve a text, piece of legislation, etc.
 
 
• **Example:** The** amendment** to the law was passed unanimously.
